description: §42.2.3 / §66.7.5 — the S462 soft-deprecation covers the IN-PLACE presence guard only. The rebind head `given c = @color :> { … }` is a different form and SHALL NOT surface W-GIVEN-PRESENCE-DEPRECATED. (What the rebind head itself is — §66.7.5's narrowed instance handle, or §42.2.3's E-SYNTAX-045 — is not asserted here; only the absence of the deprecation code.)
rationale: Ruling user-voice-scrml.md S462 "a, go": the in-place presence guard is soft-deprecated; "The rebind form `given c = @h :>` (§66.7.5) is NOT affected."
